ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels with a high frequency of localized high-intensity (white) circular clusters; estimated 20:80 high-to-low intensity ratio across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-density concentration of white circular clusters along the distal and lateral margins; solid dark pigmentation in the medial regions flanking the central notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an internal pixel-mapped angle of approximately 75 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency serration along the trailing boundary; pixel-amplitude of peaks increases significantly at the lobe tips due to calcified surface protrusions.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve with initial convexity from the notch transitioning to a concave sweep toward the terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial detection of circular high-contrast white pixel clusters ranging from 5 to 20 pixels in diameter, densely packed on the outer thirds of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavily encrusted high-relief white calcifications on the distal lobe tips, altering the natural organic silhouette into a jagged, irregular geometry.
other_distinctive_markers: Vertical high-intensity pixel spray (water droplets) occluding the lower-central region where the fluke meets the peduncle.
